entities.summary: Maximus III of Constantinople, born Manuel Christonymos, was Ecumenical Patriarch of Constantinople from 1476 to his death in 1482, and a scholar. He is honoured as a saint in the Eastern Orthodox Church and his feast day is 17 November.
